images.title: *AI* customer service for ecommerce
images.sub: Order status, returns, order changes and carrier claims, and what stays with your team.

images.name: duties
images.title: A store's support inbox, *duty by duty*
rows: Answers from the order record and carrier scans, and checks when tracking looks wrong.
Sends labels, starts exchanges and refunds inside the written policy and a dollar limit.
Fixes addresses, sizes and cancellations before the order is picked.
Answers from the product page and size chart, and lists the gaps it finds.
Opens carrier traces, collects photos and files claims before the deadline.
Gathers the order and the conversation. A person decides.

images.name: sale-monday
images.title: The Monday after a *sale weekend*
rows: Answers 38 overnight "where is my order?" emails from the order records and carrier tracking.
A customer wants a different size. The order hasn't been picked, so it makes the change.
One parcel hasn't had a scan in six days. It opens a carrier trace and tells the customer what happens next.
A customer sends photos of a cracked lamp. The value is under its limit, so it ships a replacement and files the claim.
A return request arrives 12 days after the window closed. It writes up the request for the owner.
A card dispute notice lands. It gathers the order, tracking and messages for the person who responds.
A customer reports a rash from a face cream. It apologizes and sends it to the owner right away.

images.name: setup
images.title: How it *is set up* at an online store
steps: Sort them by type: order status, returns, order changes, product questions, carrier problems.
The return window, who pays return shipping, final-sale items, and the unwritten habits too.
The refund and replacement amount it can approve alone.
Store platform, help desk, shipping software and carriers. No payment settings, no price edits.
Exceptions, disputes, fraud signs, safety complaints and upset customers go to a named person.
It drafts every reply while someone approves each one, starting with order status.
Update the rules before every sale and every policy change.
